signals.name: Engine RPM
signals.description: confidence=high; r = 0.99999984 against the tuning tool's RPM column

signals.name: Manifold absolute pressure
signals.description: confidence=high; matches the tuning tool's MAP column; a 282 kPa absolute peak under full boost lines up with the in-car display reading 1.83 bar gauge

signals.name: Engine coolant temperature
signals.description: confidence=high; agrees item by item with the in-car coolant temperature display

signals.name: Intake air temperature
signals.description: confidence=high; matches the tuning tool's IAT column

signals.name: Manifold pressure (8-bit)
signals.description: confidence=medium; a coarse MAP, r = 0.995 against the 16-bit one; saturates at 255 under high boost, so the 8-bit range is insufficient

signals.name: Barometric pressure
signals.description: confidence=medium; two integer points on two days (1006 hPa→100, 1009 hPa→101); VSA `4005[21]` carries the same value

signals.name: Vehicle speed
signals.description: confidence=high; verified 0–114 km/h; the 0.621 slope against the tool's mph column is exactly the unit conversion

signals.name: Ignition advance
signals.description: confidence=high; matches the tuning tool's ignition advance column

signals.name: Battery voltage
signals.description: confidence=high; 96% of samples agree point for point with the tuning tool

signals.name: Injector pulse width
signals.description: confidence=high; matches the tuning tool's injector pulse width column

signals.name: Fuel pump duty
signals.description: confidence=medium; stands in a 10/9 normalised relation to another channel, which looks more like a pump duty cycle than a low-side fuel pressure

signals.name: A/C request
signals.description: confidence=medium; takes 0x00 / 0x01 / 0x03 in the archive: 0x01 with the key on and the engine off, 0x03 about 5 s after start. bit1 is exactly the bit the public signal set points at, but nobody ever marked the A/C switch, so this stays a candidate

signals.name: Mass air flow
signals.description: confidence=high; r = 0.99996 against the relation AFM.c = 30000·AFM/RPM

signals.name: Boost load state
signals.description: confidence=medium; re-checked over the whole archive (31 logs, 53,908 samples, 180 state changes): every non-zero state has MAP_ABS ≥ 100.25 kPa. A single pressure threshold and a Schmitt hysteresis are both refuted; state 2 has only 8 independent entries, so its threshold is not identifiable

signals.name: Air charge (8-bit)
signals.description: confidence=medium; unit=flashpro_AIRC_unit (OBDb 无对应枚举); r = 0.99 against the tuning tool's air-charge column; an 8-bit version of it

signals.name: Intake air temperature 2
signals.description: confidence=high; matches the tuning tool's IAT2 column; the physical location is not inferred from the name

signals.name: Engine oil pressure (8-bit)
signals.description: confidence=medium; r = 0.99995 against the 16-bit oil pressure, but its zero is not zero (raw = 38 at a true 0 kPa), so it cannot be used as a pressure directly

signals.name: Engine oil pressure
signals.description: confidence=high; 2,021 samples at zero engine speed read exactly 0 while the same responses carry BARO = 101 and MAP = 100.3, which rules out a dead sensor; idle readings of 241 / 251 against an in-car 252 support a gauge-pressure reading

signals.name: Manifold pressure (mmHg scale)
signals.description: confidence=medium; unit=mmHg (OBDb 无对应枚举); r = 0.994 against MAP; the 0.1 mmHg/LSB unit is an assumption

signals.name: Lambda (alternate)
signals.description: confidence=medium; only ever moves within 0.997–1.016; possibly a second sensor or a filtered value

signals.name: Lambda
signals.description: confidence=high; AFR = λ × 14.7; the public signal set decodes the same bytes as ×29.4/65535 = AFR, which agrees

signals.name: Short term fuel trim
signals.description: confidence=high; exact coefficient 0.78125·raw − 100 recovered from unrounded values

signals.name: Long term fuel trim
signals.description: confidence=high; same encoding as short-term trim

signals.name: Lambda target
signals.description: confidence=high; its difference from measured lambda is the error the closed loop is chasing

signals.name: Fuel system status
signals.description: confidence=high; only the values 2 and 4 have been observed

signals.name: Intake cam phase target
signals.description: confidence=high; corrected to 53 − 0.5·raw from unrounded values

signals.name: Intake cam phase
signals.description: confidence=high; same encoding; its difference from the command shows the VTC response

signals.name: VTEC engaged
signals.description: confidence=high; 0/2 = off, 1/3 = on (bit0)

signals.name: Gear
signals.description: confidence=high; 96% agreement with the speed/rpm ratio while driving; 0 means neutral or clutch depressed. The reverse value has never been seen — selecting reverse still reads 0

signals.name: Accelerator pedal
signals.description: confidence=high; accelerator pedal position, distinct from throttle

signals.name: Throttle position
signals.description: confidence=high; actual electronic throttle position; it does not track the pedal one to one

signals.name: Boost pressure (absolute)
signals.description: confidence=high; pressure ahead of the throttle, different from MAP at idle; up to 202–215 kPa absolute while driving

signals.name: Boost pressure target
signals.description: confidence=high; the target, same encoding

signals.name: Wastegate position
signals.description: confidence=high; signed: of 42,797 samples, 41,971 are ≤9000 and 826 are ≥65000, with nothing in between; 34 adjacent-sample transitions cross the sign boundary and read as >30000 jumps unsigned but as zero jumps signed

signals.name: Wastegate position target
signals.description: confidence=high; never negative, so it is still read unsigned; the millimetre unit is unproven

signals.name: Air charge
signals.description: confidence=high; the ECU's primary load quantity, reaching 218% under boost. It must not be mapped onto OBD calculated load

signals.name: Exhaust cam phase
signals.description: confidence=high; coefficient 0.2·raw − 23 recovered from unrounded values

signals.name: Exhaust cam phase target
signals.description: confidence=high; same encoding

signals.name: Catalyst temperature
signals.description: confidence=high; an ECU model value; observed 303–766 °C

signals.name: Direct injection fuel pressure
signals.description: confidence=high; actual direct-injection rail pressure, 43.5–200 bar; an earlier swap with the commanded value was corrected

signals.name: Engine oil pressure (mirror)
signals.description: confidence=high; the same quantity as in `2610` sampled at a different instant (pairs agree exactly only 79.9% of the time)

signals.name: Unresolved pressure quantity (PTANK)
signals.description: confidence=medium; unit=unresolved (OBDb 无对应枚举); the numbers look like kPa (221–296) but are implausible for tank pressure, and they correlate strongly with the air-charge limits — a limit or model quantity. Do not read it as fuel tank pressure

signals.name: Direct injection fuel pressure target
signals.description: confidence=high; r = 0.99997 against the actual value

signals.name: Requested torque
signals.description: confidence=high; a normalised percentage; the reference torque is unknown, so it cannot be converted to N·m

signals.name: Actual torque
signals.description: confidence=high; same as above

signals.name: Maximum torque (unit undetermined)
signals.description: confidence=medium; unit=unresolved (OBDb 无对应枚举); probably the torque ceiling for the current conditions; unit undetermined

signals.name: Air charge limit
signals.description: confidence=medium; `[49]` / `[57]` / `[58]` are equal at all times, so the three names are indistinguishable in this data

signals.name: Air charge protection limit
signals.description: confidence=medium; same as above

signals.name: Air charge compensation limit
signals.description: confidence=medium; same as above

signals.name: Odometer
signals.description: confidence=high; checked against the cluster reading

signals.name: Engine run time
signals.description: confidence=medium; taken from the public signal set; not independently verified here

signals.name: Knock control
signals.description: confidence=medium; taken from the public signal set; not independently verified here

signals.name: Catalyst temperature (mirror)
signals.description: confidence=high; r = 1.000 against the catalyst temperature in `2611`

signals.name: VTC actuator duty
signals.description: confidence=medium; adopted from the public signal set; on this car the raw value moves over 15..123 with engine speed. It was once mis-read as a coolant temperature duplicate

signals.name: Engine run time (copy)
signals.description: confidence=medium; equal sample by sample to the run time in `2660` (250/278; the rest differ by 1 s across a second boundary)

signals.name: Engine oil temperature (ECU model)
signals.description: confidence=high; an ECU model value. Matches the cluster point for point over 54→67 °C; the in-car display showed 54 °C where the bus read 55 °C; warm-up is continuous over 32→81 °C. No precedent in any public source; the model algorithm, the sensor arrangement and the start-up display threshold are all unverified

signals.name: Longitudinal acceleration
signals.description: confidence=medium; zero at raw = 125; r = 0.67–0.83 against acceleration differentiated from wheel speed, free slope 1.039, residual 0.030 g. Only one trip sampled wheel speed fast enough to compute dv/dt

signals.name: Wheel speed front left (VSA, coarse)
signals.description: confidence=medium; 1.5 km/h per LSB; the wheel order is inferred from the EPS packet, not independently confirmed

signals.name: Wheel speed front right (VSA, coarse)
signals.description: confidence=medium; same as above

signals.name: Wheel speed rear left (VSA, coarse)
signals.description: confidence=medium; same as above

signals.name: Wheel speed rear right (VSA, coarse)
signals.description: confidence=medium; same as above

signals.name: Brake switch
signals.description: confidence=medium; agrees with the public signal set once the MSB0 bit numbering is applied: bix 127 is byte 15 bit0

signals.name: Brake master cylinder pressure
signals.description: confidence=high; 0 at rest; the in-car display's 5 MPa and 10 MPa correspond to 50 bar and 106 bar here (about 6% apart, kept as-is)

signals.name: Barometric pressure (VSA mirror)
signals.description: confidence=medium; same value as `2610[17]`

signals.name: Brake switch (VSA mirror)
signals.description: confidence=medium; not a clean mirror of the brake switch: `[9]` only ever takes 0 / 4 / 12 and never 8, and what holds is «bit2 = pedal OR bit3». While bit3 is set, bit2 does not fall back when the pedal is released — using it as a brake indicator will keep the indicator lit throughout a Brake Hold

signals.name: Reverse gear engaged
signals.description: confidence=high; four transitions across two reversing manoeuvres while driving, plus a 30 s stationary segment held in reverse

signals.name: Driver seatbelt fastened
signals.description: confidence=high; two independent unfasten / fasten actions: cleared on unfasten, set on fasten

signals.name: Brake Hold enabled
signals.description: confidence=medium; synchronous with the cluster bit `7021[7] bit7`; verified by a single stationary press / cancel, needs repeating

signals.name: Clutch pedal travel
signals.description: confidence=high; fully separated (0 / 100) across five stationary press-and-release cycles; intermediate values such as 3–36 appear when shifting on the move, so it is travel in percent, not a switch

signals.name: Electric parking brake applied
signals.description: confidence=medium; unit=raw (OBDb 无对应枚举); the byte becomes 0xAF when the electric parking brake is applied; single observation

signals.name: Vehicle speed (VSA)
signals.description: confidence=high; integer speed, agrees with the ECM's

signals.name: Vehicle speed (EPS copy) (0x4818)
signals.description: confidence=high; EPS-side vehicle speed duplicate (16-bit ×0.01 in `48BD`, 8-bit integer in `4818`)

signals.name: Wheel speed front left (8-bit)
signals.description: confidence=medium; 1 km/h integer version; wheel order inferred from `48C4`

signals.name: Wheel speed front right (8-bit)
signals.description: confidence=medium; same as above

signals.name: Wheel speed rear left (8-bit)
signals.description: confidence=medium; same as above

signals.name: Wheel speed rear right (8-bit)
signals.description: confidence=medium; same as above

signals.name: Steering assist mode
signals.description: confidence=high; 1 = comfort, 2 = sport, 3 = +R; a custom mode still reads 1. Consistent across three independent sessions, and the only confirmed drive-mode bit

signals.name: Steering wheel angle
signals.description: confidence=medium; 0.1°/LSB is an assumption: raw −4032 at full left lock, −26 at centre, and an eyeballed ~390° from centre to full lock gives 0.0974°/LSB. Full right lock was never captured and no instrument calibration was done

signals.name: Vehicle speed (EPS copy) (0x48BD)
signals.description: confidence=medium; EPS-side vehicle speed duplicate (16-bit ×0.01 in `48BD`, 8-bit integer in `4818`)

signals.name: Yaw rate
signals.description: confidence=medium; unit=deg/s (OBDb 无对应枚举); r = 0.982 against a model built on a 2.735 m wheelbase and a steering ratio of 13; positive is a right turn. The scale is not calibrated: a wheel-speed geometry method gives a pooled point estimate of 0.004214 with an error-budget interval of [0.00239, 0.00604], and the 43.4% systematic error dwarfs the 14.7% gap between the two candidate scales

signals.name: Steering wheel angle (copy)
signals.description: confidence=medium; r = 0.96 against the steering angle in `48BD`

signals.name: Wheel speed front left
signals.description: confidence=high; r = 0.997 against ECM vehicle speed; the wheel order comes from outer wheels running faster in a turn and front wheels faster under acceleration

signals.name: Wheel speed front right
signals.description: confidence=high; same as above

signals.name: Wheel speed rear left
signals.description: confidence=high; same as above

signals.name: Wheel speed rear right
signals.description: confidence=high; same as above

signals.name: Seatbelt warning (cluster)
signals.description: confidence=medium; inverted polarity relative to the VSA bit (here 1 means not fastened)

signals.name: Electric parking brake indicator (cluster)
signals.description: confidence=medium; set when the electric parking brake is applied; single observation

signals.name: Brake Hold enabled (cluster)
signals.description: confidence=medium; synchronous with VSA `4007[21] bit1` (set at +77 s, cleared at +87 s)

signals.name: Odometer (cluster)
signals.description: confidence=high; same value and same unit (km) as the ECM odometer — the public archive's «miles» is wrong

signals.name: Ambient temperature
signals.description: confidence=high; raw = 28 corresponds to 28 °C on the in-car display, with no −40 offset (the public archive's −40 does not hold on this car); `[15]` carries the same value. Negative-temperature encoding could never be verified at the capture location

signals.name: Fuel level
signals.description: confidence=high; a smooth 16.57→16.46 L over ten minutes of idling (≈0.66 L/h)
